tools.name: options_surface_pricer
tools.description: Use this instead of estimating Greeks or adding a handmade American premium. European prices are Black-Scholes. American puts, and calls with dividends, use a 128-step binomial tree plus a European control variate. A zero-dividend American call matches the European call. The call surface is checked

tools.name: instant_signal_backtest
tools.description: Verify a signal before recommending it. The signal earns the next bar only, so same-bar prices are not treated as tradable. Slippage is one square-root impact from depth and size, not a live order book. Returns Sharpe, Sortino, drawdown, and an approximate deflated Sharpe. Not investment advice.

tools.name: portfolio_stress_verifier
tools.description: Run this before suggesting a rebalance. Normal VaR understates the tail: the report also returns a Student-t copula CVaR and Euler risk contributions. Crisis shocks repair the correlation matrix before applying the shock. Supply weights, vols, betas, and a correlation matrix. Not a historical path r

tools.name: microstructure_coint_test
tools.description: Use this for a two-asset pairs check instead of eyeballing a hedge ratio. Returns an Engle-Granger Dickey-Fuller p-value, OLS and Kalman hedge ratios, half-life, and z-score. Two series only. Not a Johansen test and not investment advice.
